summary: We created an illustrated visual narrative featuring a curious student, Adam, and his teacher, Cikgu Noraini, in a Malaysian classroom setting. Using humor, relatable cultural metaphors—like comparing lunar landers to traditional ancestral homes (Rumah Tok) and rovers to heroes on a deep-space retirement (Bilik Rehat)—the project brings inactive spacecraft like the Apollo descent stages, Mars rovers (Spirit and Opportunity), and Venus landers to life.Young space enthusiasts often hear only about active missions, viewing retired hardware as space trash. By reframing these discarded machines as Harta Warisan (space heritage) and silent monuments to human ingenuity, this storybook makes complex aerospace history accessible, fun, and culturally resonant. Ultimately, honoring the groundbreaking science of past explorers inspires the next generation of angkasawan (astronauts) and engineers to build the future of space exploration.
details: Abandoned but Not Forgotten uses visual storytelling and sequential comic panels to introduce school-age children to retired spacecraft resting on the Moon, Mars, and Venus. Through an interactive classroom dialogue between a curious student named Adam and his teacher, Cikgu Noraini, the comic breaks down complex space exploration milestones into bite-sized, humorous narratives. It personifies machines—giving them funny dialogue, sleep habits, and final messages—to show how they still stand as monuments to past discoveries.
